semantics.timing: Stage ms is inclusive; selfMs excludes instrumented children only. Do not sum inclusive stages.
semantics.cache: paragraphCache selfMs includes key/clone/rebase/map overhead; these private functions are not separately timed.
semantics.latency: Event timestamp to capture listener is a browser dispatch proxy, not OS/hardware latency. Driver RTT includes IPC and scheduling.
semantics.paint: rAF gaps and settle barriers are scheduling observations, not actual presentation latency; screenshots verify endpoints, trace provides frame evidence.
semantics.queue: driver samples track offered/acknowledged calls; pendingHandlers and exact content checks track completion. No internal Worker queue is inferred.
semantics.startup: Fresh page/editor per case. Cold = first edit after startup; warmup uses real x/Backspace pairs. Browser/font OS caches are not flushed.
semantics.repeat: Repeated Playwright keyboard.down generates trusted repeat events; not an OS repeat-timer or real IME test.
semantics.workload: ASCII editing lane capacity=ceil(duration*rate)+8, prepared before editor construction inside a selected text scope. Surrounding mixed content is unchanged.
